title: Co-founder and CEO
segment: AI SRE / incident-remediation agents with own post-trained model (SRE-1)
icp_segment: (a) trains and serves its own model; inference-heavy AI product
top_signal: Launched SRE-1 on 18 Nov 2026: a 27B-parameter model built on open weights, RL-trained by a 16-person AI research team in a 7.4-day final run on up to 512 GPUs; SRE-1 is served only on Resolve's own platform, and Primary On-call (agents take production pages before humans; up to 80% of alerts handled) went GA the same day
why_now: It now runs its own 27B model behind an always-on agent on the critical path for customers such as Salesforce, Coinbase, DoorDash, Nasdaq and SAP. Serving one model for every production page, plus more RL runs from the Resolve AI Labs research unit (launched Apr 2026), points to steady inference and training demand. Caveat: SRE-1 was trained on Snowflake Cortex Training, a serverless service where Resolve was the first design partner, so it has not yet shown appetite for dedicated capacity. Pitch dedicated Blackwell for serving and continuous RL.
cash_flow: unknown: VC-backed, $190M+ raised incl. $40M Series A extension at $1.5B valuation (Apr 2026); no revenue or profitability disclosed (SiliconANGLE 19 Nov 2026)
jan_2027_ready: yes: in-house research team already ran a 512-GPU job; buys compute through Snowflake today

title: Founder and CEO
icp_segment: (a) trains own models: computer-vision perception models (vessel detection/classification/tracking) on proprietary SmartMast camera+radio data
top_signal: Series B of $140M: about $100M equity (preempted by Insight Partners, with Overmatch Ventures and First Round) plus a $40M Stifel debt facility, four months after a $43M Series A. SmartMast is on 650+ vessels in 25 countries, and each unit records tens of GB a day. The company is hiring Machine Perception (Vision) Engineers to design, train and deploy vision models, with GPU-accelerated/TensorRT inference.
why_now: Fresh $100M of equity closed in late Sep 2026. Manufacturing capacity has doubled and the company is moving to fleet-wide SmartMast deployments (800+ shipped, 650+ live), so its proprietary video/RF dataset is growing fast. The CEO says the company has its own data source and is building maritime AI on it. Training-side GPU demand is plausible but the company has not stated it; on-vessel inference runs on NVIDIA Jetson edge hardware.
cash_flow: unknown: no revenue or profitability disclosed (TechCrunch 2026-09-28)
jan_2027_ready: unclear: no public statement of cluster or capacity need; a 1-block pilot for perception and foundation-model training is the realistic ask
